name: Moneta Digital
collateral: Mexican peso fiat reserves held in regulated and liquid bank reserves; Moneta Digital is registered with the Tax Administration Service (SAT) for virtual-asset exchange and discloses reserves through periodic third-party accounting attestations
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed 1:1 mint and redemption against MXN deposits; users can redeem MMXN for fiat pesos via the TruBit platform with SPEI bank settlement

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: centralized issuer with discretionary mint/burn/pause authority on the ERC-20 contract (ERC20Mintable, ERC20Burnable, ERC20Pausable); holder-balance freeze surface not independently confirmed.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Pharos lane D Wave 3 non-USD review

notices.title: Weaker attestation than tracked MXNB
notices.message: Moneta Digital self-reports MXN reserves without the formal quarterly audit cadence published by Bitso/Juno for MXNB. Reserve sufficiency and circulating supply consistency should be reviewed via on-chain explorers (Etherscan and Tronscan) until an independent attestation source is verified.
